title: Everything You Need To know!!......... *WINSPACE AGILE*

takeaways.text: Details include a cup-style seatpost clamp for alloy or carbon rails, hidden thru-axle holes that rule out older wheel-on trainers, a T47 threaded bottom bracket and a round steerer with an oversized bearing for easier cable routing.
Before launch he had heard of a price around US$1,900, against about US$1,680–1,780 for the T1550; he said it uses T800 carbon.
He dislikes the bulky top headset cap, which leaves a hump even with the stem slammed.
The pre-production size-M bare frame with hanger and adapter weighed about 930 g; with fork, bearings, spacers and an uncut steerer the frameset reached about 1,650 g. Production frames may differ.

disclosure: GC Performance is a Winspace retailer with a discount code. This is a pre-production frame with unfinished paint, before launch pricing was confirmed.
summary: A walkaround and weigh-in of a pre-production size-M Winspace Agile before launch.
